children: If ETH breaks above $2,538, cumulative short liquidation intensity on major centralized exchanges would reach $611 million. According to ChainCatcher, Coinglass data also shows that if ETH falls below $2,304, cumulative long liquidation intensity on major centralized exchanges would reach $472 million.

title: ETH Above $2,538 Could Bring $611 Million in Short Liquidation Intensity on Major CEXs
